# D4 Filter Generator extension

`d4-filter-generator-extension.zip` is the D4 Filter Generator browser extension for Chrome and Edge. It reads a maxroll.gg or mobalytics.gg build guide from a tab you already have open and turns it into a Diablo IV loot filter import code.

## Install

1. Download [d4-filter-generator-extension.zip](https://github.com/ranxxerox/d4-filter-generator/releases/latest/download/d4-filter-generator-extension.zip) and unzip it. The archive holds one folder named `extension`.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` in Chrome, or `edge://extensions` in Edge.
3. Turn on Developer mode.
4. Click "Load unpacked" and select the `extension` folder.
5. Reload any guide importer tab that was already open.

## Help

Full install steps, in-game import instructions, and fixes for a missing extension, a missing guide tab, or a missing payload are in the [README troubleshooting section](https://github.com/ranxxerox/d4-filter-generator#troubleshooting).
